title: AI 会话视图 ConversationData + Message — v2
description:
v2 adds two optional fields to the conversation view: `title` (a name the user gave the conversation — the work ledger) and `messageCount`. Both are additive: `required` is unchanged, so a v1-shaped payload stays valid and the frozen v1 sample still validates. GET /ai/conversations (list items and a single conversation) and GET /ai/conversations/:id share this view (toData; list items carry only the most recent messages). The frozen `role` enum and the derived `timestamp` are unchanged from v1.

v2 给会话视图加两个**可选**字段：`title`（用户给会话起的名字——工作账本）与 `messageCount`。两者都是加性变更：`required` 不变，故 v1 形态的载荷仍然合法、冻结的 v1 样例也照旧通过。GET /ai/conversations（列表项与单会话）与 GET /ai/conversations/:id 共用本视图（toData；列表项只取最近消息）。v1 冻结的 `role` 枚举与派生的 `timestamp` 不变。来源：src/ai/conversation/conversation.service.ts toData；v1 冻结历史见 schemas/v1/conversation-data.schema.json。

title.description: 工作账本：用户命名的会话标题（未设时字段缺席，前端回退到首条消息派生的预览）

messageCount.description: 会话消息条数（结构信息，不含内容）
